question: Which of the following is used in solar cookers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirror**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirrors:-**

 
 
• These are used in solar cookers to reflect and concentrate sunlight onto the cooking pot or surface.
 
• The reflective surface of the mirror can be made of various materials such as glass, metal, or plastic.
 
• The mirror can be adjusted to track the movement of the sun throughout the day to ensure maximum sunlight is captured.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrical supply:-**

 
 
• It is not used in solar cookers as they rely solely on the energy from the sun.
 
 
 
• **Solar plates:-**
 
 
• These are not commonly used in solar cookers as they are typically used for generating electricity, not for cooking food.
 
 
 
• **Electrochemical cells:-**
 
 
• These are also not used in solar cookers as they are typically used for storing energy, not for cooking food.
